name: Medito
one_liner: Free meditation app from a Dutch nonprofit: guided meditations, beginner courses, sleep stories and breathing exercises, no account needed.
best_for: People who want guided meditation and sleep content without paying
Beginners who want a structured introductory course
People who prefer not to create an account
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for treatment of a diagnosed condition
People who want no advertising-measurement tracking by default
short_description: A free, nonprofit meditation app with guided sessions, courses, sleep stories and a timer; funded by donations.
long_description: Medito is a meditation app run by the Medito Foundation, a Dutch nonprofit. Everything in it is free: guided meditations, beginner courses, sleep stories and sounds, breathing exercises and a timer, and you can use it without creating an account. It is funded by donations. Its privacy policy says it does not sell personal information, but by default the app includes Meta's SDK, which can send your device's advertising identifier to Meta to measure Medito's own ad campaigns, plus Google Firebase analytics; you can switch these off in the app's privacy settings. There is no published study of the Medito app itself.
patient_summary: You download the app and start a guided meditation, course or sleep story straight away, with no account and no payment. It is run by a nonprofit and funded by donations. Some third-party analytics and Meta ad-measurement tools are on by default, and you can turn them off in the app's privacy settings.

pricing.notes: All content is free; the nonprofit asks for optional donations.

privacy.notes: Does not sell data and needs no account, but Meta's SDK (advertising ID, for ad-campaign measurement) and Firebase analytics are on by default; you can turn them off in settings.

seo.title: Medito: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Medito is a completely free, nonprofit meditation app with guided meditations, courses, sleep stories and breathing exercises, and no ads or premium tier.

faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Medito before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Medito replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Medito is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Medito is available on iPhone and Android.
Guided meditations; Beginner courses and 30-day challenges; Sleep stories and sounds; Breathing exercises; Open source; no ads, no account.
